text: {"category": "application", "summary": "The orders worker crashes on an orders.paid event for an order without a customer: _flatten_customer reads data[\"customer\"] and raises KeyError: 'customer'. Container orders in pod orders-7d9f8b6c5d-x2kqp has restarted 6 times and is in CrashLoopBackOff, so paid orders are not invoiced.", "root_cause": "build_invoice validates each orders.paid message with Invoice.model_validate, and its before-validator _flatten_customer (orders/service.py, lines 23-25) indexes data[\"customer\"] without checking that the key exists. A message for an order without a customer raises KeyError: 'customer'. main catches nothing and deletes a message only after build_invoice returns, so the worker exits with code 1, Kubernetes restarts it, and the same message can crash it again when it is received again.", "confidence": "high", "evidence": [{"id": "log:previous:orders", "why": "The traceback ends in _flatten_customer at orders/service.py line 24 with KeyError: 'customer'."}, {"id": "code:snippet:1", "why": "_flatten_customer reads data[\"customer\"] without checking that the key exists."}, {"id": "code:snippet:3", "why": "main calls build_invoice before delete_message and catches no error, so one bad message stops the worker."}, {"id": "k8s:status:orders", "why": "Container orders is in CrashLoopBackOff after 6 restarts, and its last run exited with code 1."}, {"id": "k8s:event:2", "why": "Kubernetes backs off restarting the failed container."}, {"id": "dd:event:8312004415592873006", "why": "The Datadog monitor reports the crash loop of the orders deployment."}], "suspected_code": [{"snippet_id": "code:snippet:1", "path": "orders/service.py", "start_line": 23, "end_line": 25, "symbol": "_flatten_customer"}, {"snippet_id": "code:snippet:2", "path": "orders/service.py", "start_line": 32, "end_line": 34, "symbol": "build_invoice"}], "recommended_actions": ["Handle an order without a customer in _flatten_customer: fail its validation with a clear error instead of a KeyError.", "In main, catch the error of one message, log its order ID and leave it to the queue's dead-letter queue, so that one bad order cannot stop the worker.", "Find the producer that publishes orders.paid events without a customer, and fix it."], "needs_human": false}
